distance_model_note: The distance difference is not an error of the implementation: the implementation propagates the constant space velocity model r(t) = r0 + v dt, so the distance is the norm of the propagated position and carries the second order term of the tangential motion; the reference (ERFA pmsky, reached through astropy apply_space_motion) updates the distance with its own rule and does not carry that term.  The two models agree on the direction: the angular difference is the verdict of this comparison.  The relative distance difference is at most 5.5e-6, far below the position uncertainty of a catalogue source.
